name: spreadsheetSetFitToPage
description: Sets the fit-to-page print option on the active sheet of a spreadsheet workbook. When state is true the sheet is scaled to fit across pagesWide columns and pagesHigh rows (each minimum 1); when false the fit-to-page setting is cleared. The fluent member form is setFitToPage(state, pagesWide, pagesHigh).

params.name: state
params.description: True to enable fit-to-page, false to clear it (default true).

params.name: pagesWide
params.description: Number of pages wide to fit into (default 1, minimum 1 when enabled).

params.name: pagesHigh
params.description: Number of pages high to fit into (default 1, minimum 1 when enabled).

examples.title: Fit to a single page
examples.description: Scale the active sheet to one page wide by one page high.
